The builder anchor 763732->405424 is off by 4 (entitiesLoD starts at 405420). Count 768 for entities and 400 for weapons are derived from block sizes (no explicit loop bound was read). The child struct resizes (playerState_s, entityState_t, clientState_t, ScoreboardInfo, EntityLoDs, WeaponMapEntry count) belong to their own agents; this struct's layout depends on them.
